title: Compiler release exceeds the configured JDK
root_cause: The Maven manifest raised the compiler release from 21 to 23 while the workflow still selects JDK 21. That compiler cannot target release 23, so compilation stops before verification completes.

relevant_evidence.why: Maven invokes the compiler with release 23.
The compiler reports that release 23 is unsupported.
The manifest sets the requested release.
